notes: **2026-10-03** — Versions chosen (looked up 2026-10-03). Compose BOM 2026.09.00: ui/foundation/runtime 1.12.1, material3 1.4.0, material-icons-extended 1.7.8 (developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/bom/bom-mapping). AGP stays 8.13.2: max API 36.1 (developer.android.com/build/releases/past-releases/agp-8-13-0-release-notes). Room stays 2.6.0 unless Kotlin forces it. Open risk: Compose release notes mention compileSdk 37.1 from the 1.13 line; AGP 8.13 supports only up to 36.1, so fall back to an older BOM if checkDebugAarMetadata fails (an AGP bump is out of scope). Baseline: debug APK 19103397 bytes; releaseRuntimeClasspath tree 658 dependency lines; kotlinx-coroutines resolves to 1.7.3 at runtime.

**2026-10-03** — Deviations found while building. (1) Compose BOM 2026.09.00 (Compose 1.12.1) needs compileSdk 37, but AGP 8.13.2 supports at most 36.1, so BOM 2026.06.01 (Compose 1.11.4, material3 1.4.0; needs compileSdk 35) is used instead. (2) Lifecycle 2.11.0 needs compileSdk 37 and AGP 9.1.0+ (docs: AGP 9.2.0 for Compose compileSdk), so lifecycle 2.10.0 is used (developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/lifecycle). (3) activity-compose 1.13.0 and core-ktx 1.18.0 (transitive) need compileSdk 36. Platform android-36 is not installed but android-36.1 is, so app/build.gradle uses compileSdkVersion 'android-36.1' instead of installing a platform. (4) Room 2.6.0 kapt fails under Kotlin 2.4.20 with 'Unable to read Kotlin metadata due to unsupported metadata kind', so Room is raised to 2.8.5 (developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/room), still on kapt.

notes: **2026-10-04** — Baseline on current main (aosp-atd): 38 tests, 3 failures, all Espresso.pressBack RootViewWithoutFocusException (backFromDetail, backFromSettings, backFromArchived); S15 text fixes held. A temporary dumpsys diagnostic in backFromSettings showed the focused window was "Application Not Responding: system" with MainActivity top-resumed; which process the ANR is for was not found. Fix (9bb1380): NavigationTest pressBack() helper uses onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() instead of Espresso.pressBack. Local ./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest: 38 tests, 0 failures (6m20s). Not yet checked: GitHub instrumented job. DEVELOPERS.md still says the job stays red until S61; not changed here.

**2026-10-04** — Correction: DEVELOPERS.md was changed after the note above. Commit e3b77a9 removes the sentence "The job stays red until S61." from the Local Test Runs section. The GitHub instrumented job is still not checked.

goals:
- Ship a local-first Android habit/measurement tracker to F-Droid, Google Play and GitHub releases.
- Entries are the source of truth; streaks, totals and trends are derived and editable through history.
- One-tap daily logging with a clear "done today" state.
- Reliable local reminders without exact-alarm permission.
- Portable data: versioned JSON backup (import replaces state) and flat CSV export.
- FLOSS-clean (MPL-2.0): no proprietary dependencies, analytics, ads or accounts.
non_goals:
- Cloud sync, accounts or collaboration.
- iOS / Kotlin Multiplatform (tracked as later items).
- Widgets.
- Encrypted backups or at-rest encryption (tracked as later items).
- Advanced analytics suite.
- Squalor brand marks in the APK (brand marks are all-rights-reserved; the app icon is app-specific and MPL-2.0).
